channel.title: Pier & Point · Potrero Power Station Block 13
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Potrero Power Station Block 13 (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 13: The April 2020 Board approval covers the Design for Development that lists Block 13. The Planning Commission had already approved that document on January 30, 2020.
item.description: The April 2020 Board approval covers the Design for Development that lists Block 13. The Planning Commission had already approved that document on January 30, 2020. Source: Planning Commission Resolution No. 21156, July 28, 2022 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); Potrero Power Station Design for Development, Feb 26, 2020 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf).

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 13: Block 13's record and map notes no longer say the D4D shows 280 ft and 300 ft towers: on Figure 6.2.3 those labels are dimension lines, and the block's height limits are 85 ft and 125 ft, so the alleged inconsistency with the midrise text is removed. The block is now described as sitting in the 4.8-acre PG&E-owned northern switchyard area (SF Planning project page; D4D Figure 1.2.1), not vacant land, with build-out dependent on the switchyard's relocation; an addressed Assessor lot (4175499, 1101 Illinois St) overlaps the footprint but is not confirmed as that parcel. The 2035 completion is kept as a Phase 3 forecast from SocketSite's October 2020 schedule table (Block 13 vertical development 2031-2035) instead of a whole-project target. Sources now point to the final D4D rather than a dead 2019 draft link, D4D publishers are shown as SF Planning, and one image is labelled a document, not a rendering.

item.title: Expected · Potrero Power Station Block 13: Completion expected: Block 13 is in Phase 3 of the revised phasing, and SocketSite's October 2020 schedule table lists its vertical development 2031-2035 (it is not in the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list: Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15) (~2035)

item.title: Planned · Potrero Power Station Block 13: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero Power Station project and Development Agreement (Ordinance No. 62-20, Board File 200040), the entitlement covering the adopted Design for Development, whose Land Use Table (Table 3.1.1) lists Block 13; the Development Agreement's own effective date is May 25, 2020, distinct from the D4D's own February 26, 2020 final-document date (Apr 21, 2020)
